parameters.note: Eagle Creek is a tributary of Lake Tahoe (it flows through Eagle Canyon and over Eagle Falls into Emerald Bay, El Dorado Co.). It is not listed by its own name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), but it falls under the Lake Tahoe tributaries entry §7.50(b)(152)(A), which applies to 'Tahoe Lake tributaries upstream to the first lake' — here from Emerald Bay up to Eagle Lake, the first lake upstream. Per §7.50(a)(1), waters listed in subsection (b) are closed to all fishing except during the shown open season — so the creek is closed Oct. 1 through the Friday preceding the Saturday before Memorial Day. Date_spec encodes 'Saturday preceding Memorial Day' as the last Monday of May (Memorial Day) minus 2 days, since the resolver has no anchor_holiday implementation.

candidates.summary: Open catch-and-release only, Saturday before Memorial Day through Sept. 30; closed to all fishing the rest of the year (Lake Tahoe tributary special regulation).

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license. Eagle Creek is wholly within California (El Dorado Co.); the Lake Tahoe CA/NV license reciprocity applies to fishing in the lake itself, not to this tributary.
